channel.title: Cassandra | System Design
channel.description: In-depth system design tutorials — from zero to millions of users. Written for engineers who want to understand how large-scale systems actually work.

item.title: Design a Distributed Email Service
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: A billion users, two exabytes a year, and protocols designed in the 1980s. Why email storage dwarfs everything else in this series, how denormalisation answers a query NoSQL refuses, and the part that isn't engineering at all — with an interactive deliverability checker.
item.content:encoded:
A billion users, two exabytes a year, and protocols designed in the 1980s. Why email storage dwarfs everything else in this series, how denormalisation answers a query NoSQL refuses, and the part that isn't engineering at all — with an interactive deliverability checker.

item.title: Design Google Maps
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: One billion daily users, 100 petabytes of map tiles, and a road graph too big to fit in memory. Routing tiles, the CDN economics of map rendering, adaptive rerouting — plus an interactive tile explorer, and why the real tile URL is not what the textbook says.
item.content:encoded:
One billion daily users, 100 petabytes of map tiles, and a road graph too big to fit in memory. Routing tiles, the CDN economics of map rendering, adaptive rerouting — plus an interactive tile explorer, and why the real tile URL is not what the textbook says.

item.title: Design a Key-Value Store
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: A complete beginner-friendly guide to designing a distributed key-value store — covering CAP theorem, quorum consensus, vector clocks, gossip protocol, Merkle trees, and the write/read paths inspired by DynamoDB and Cassandra.

item.title: Design Consistent Hashing
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: A beginner-friendly deep dive into consistent hashing — the algorithm that powers Amazon DynamoDB, Apache Cassandra, Discord, and Akamai CDN. Understand hash rings, virtual nodes, and why this algorithm changed distributed systems forever.
